text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after going to a video rental shop with Fine Motion…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Princess Fighter was so good! I can see why you love it so much, Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: If even someone descended from real princesses approves, then Princess Fighter really is the greatest!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm sure the movie you choose will be amazing too! ♪
choice_data_list: You two seem like you're having fun.
You two seem like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Japanese films and animations are so interesting.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Kawakami and I are planning to watch a film I pick out today.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! Would it be okay for my trainer to join us?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: By all means! Movies are more exciting the more people you watch with.
choice_data_list: Then I guess I'll take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, all right! ♪ I'm going to choose something special just for the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's time for our grand movie night to begin! Fine, if you please. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I've chosen a romance film! The title is…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shogun Shark Returns ! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, What a strangely catchy title! I admit I'm also not sure where the romance will come into play!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The cover just looked so interesting. And the title makes it sound like a sequel even though it's not!
choice_data_list: It's clearly a B mov—ah, nevermind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Looking at their beaming faces, I can't bring myself to put a damper on their enthusiasm, so we start the movie.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Are those girls falling from the sky?! No, wait—it's pouring sharks!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The problem is that top-ranking officials aren't acting in this time of emergency. While they're busy trying to shift responsibility, the sharks keep coming!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Whoa! The island is floating! No way! Are you telling me the whole island is a defense facility?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The tables have turned now! Nail them with the love missile!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shogun or not, it's still a shark… Sure enough, it looks like they might be able to kill the sharks with fire!

text_block_list.name: Fine and Kawakami
text_block_list.text: GET 'EM!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That… was… phenomenal! What a splendid piece of cinema.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shogun Shark Returns truly is a masterpiece! Don't you agree, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Your taste in movies surprised me.
Your taste in movies surprised me.
Maybe we should watch something else too…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shogun Shark Returns truly is a masterpiece! Don't you agree, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Your taste in movies surprised me.
Your taste in movies surprised me.
Maybe we should watch something else too…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, I really loved the succession of wild plot twists and how you never knew when the shogun was going to show up!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: From beginning to end, it was action-packed and so… free-form!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Every film I've watched until now was aimed at teaching customs, ideologies, or history. This was a breath of fresh air!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And it was so fun watching it together with everyone, laughing and shouting at the screen!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I couldn't agree more! I'd be honored to join you for another movie whenever you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maybe it was inevitable that someone under as many constraints as Fine Motion would be drawn to an uninhibited B movie.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm happy she's discovered yet one more thing to love.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okay. How about… Revival of the Zombie Kingdom, Bizarre Tales: Catch the Golden Kappa! , or Mecha-Umamusume ?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There are many more films I'm interested in watching too, so we're not lacking for choice!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! Maybe I should tell everyone back in Ireland about the best ones. I'm sure they would broaden their horizons. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's just like you, Fine! I'd like to request that you include Princess Fighter on that list too!
choice_data_list: M-maybe we shouldn't be too hasty…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm glad that Fine Motion is enjoying Japanese films. All the same…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm determined to get her to watch a wider range of genres before her recommendations get too slanted.
